title: Appearance
body: The calendar works fine but has the ugliest app icon. When is the last time this was redesigned?? The competition looks way much attractive.
author: 2Pac Eklektos

title: Mismatch in desktop and iPad calendar
body: There’s a problem with the syncing of events across my devices. Today I set some events on my pc then on checking them on my iPad I found out that 3 hour delay had been added. So instead of an event starting at 7 it starts at 10. Please fix this!
author: G.omae

title: iOS14
body: Hello can you kindly create a widget for the app to help out iPhone users 😩.. Also can the logo of the calendar be dynamic to show the current day and date other than just “31”. Regards

title: Simple and Excellent !
body: Does the job well. Easy to use. Great Interface
author: kabbzie

title: It’s a little restrictive
body: I am an executive assistant so I need access to my boss’s calendar which this app gives me so that’s great however I can’t input bookings and events for her only myself so I’m forced to open my laptop to do that which is annoying. The app only gives me the Liberty to view her calendar not edit it or anything. Hopefully this is a feature they add soon
author: CozitsCass

title: Not nice
body: Why is your app logo always on 31 it should display the date today
